attributes.name: @axis
attributes.summary: Axis argument for reductions and softmax.

attributes.name: @channel
attributes.summary: Load one channel from an audio asset.

attributes.name: @default
attributes.summary: Default value for params and generated modulation helpers.

attributes.name: @end
attributes.summary: Audio load end time in seconds.

attributes.name: @generated-for
attributes.summary: Associates a generated helper parameter with a user parameter.

attributes.name: @hidden
attributes.summary: Hide a generated or internal parameter from normal host presentation.

attributes.name: @hop
attributes.summary: Hop size for STFT and hop-rate operators.

attributes.name: @hops
attributes.summary: Fixed delay in hops for spectrum-delay.

attributes.name: @max-hops
attributes.summary: Maximum modulated delay in hops for spectrum-delay-mod.

attributes.name: @mod-depth-max
attributes.summary: Upper bound for generated modulation depth control.

attributes.name: @mod-depth-min
attributes.summary: Lower bound for generated modulation depth control.

attributes.name: @mod-mode
attributes.summary: Modulation mode: additive, multiplicative, or semitone.

attributes.name: @modulator
attributes.summary: Marks an input as a modulation source slot.

attributes.name: @normalize
attributes.summary: Audio load normalization mode, e.g. peak.

attributes.name: @start
attributes.summary: Audio load start time in seconds.

operators.name: delay
operators.summary: Delay by a time in samples.

operators.name: fft
operators.summary: FFT returning `(real imag)`; also updates legacy `__fft_re` and `__fft_im`.

operators.name: hop-hold
operators.summary: Hold a signal, tensor, or signalTensor for one hop interval.

operators.name: ifft
operators.summary: Inverse FFT from real and imaginary parts.

operators.name: ir
operators.summary: Load a WAV file as an impulse-response tensor.

operators.name: max
operators.summary: Maximum. The parser rewrites n-ary forms into nested binary calls.

operators.name: min
operators.summary: Minimum. The parser rewrites n-ary forms into nested binary calls.

operators.name: noise
operators.summary: White noise, or per-bin tensor noise with optional hop-rate updates.

operators.name: overlap-add
operators.summary: Scatter-add a signalTensor into an output signal.

operators.name: partition-ir
operators.summary: Prepartition an impulse response, returning `(irRe irIm)`.

operators.name: partitioned-convolve
operators.summary: High-level partitioned convolution from signal and IR tensor.

operators.name: partitioned-spectral-mac
operators.summary: Multiply-accumulate an input spectrum against partitioned IR spectra, returning `(real imag)`.

operators.name: peek
operators.summary: Read a scalar from a tensor.

operators.name: peek-row
operators.summary: Read a tensor row as a signalTensor.

operators.name: phase-vocoder
operators.summary: Phase-vocoder bin remap/pitch transform, returning `(real imag)`.

operators.name: polar-fft
operators.summary: Convert rectangular complex spectrum to `(magnitude phase)`.

operators.name: ramp2trig
operators.summary: Convert a ramp wrap into a trigger.

operators.name: sample
operators.summary: Interpolated row read from a tensor.

operators.name: spectrum-delay
operators.summary: Delay a spectrum by a fixed number of hops.

operators.name: spectrum-delay-mod
operators.summary: Delay a spectrum by a signal-controlled number of hops.

operators.name: tensor
operators.summary: Zero-filled tensor alias, or inline data tensor with @shape/@data.

operators.name: to-signal
operators.summary: Convert a 1D tensor into a signal playback source.

operators.name: triangle
operators.summary: Convert a 0..1 phase to a -1..1 triangle.

operators.name: window
operators.summary: Named window tensor. Currently supports Hann.

operators.name: windows
operators.summary: Extract sliding windows / im2col-style tensor view.

special_forms.name: def
special_forms.summary: Bind a symbol to the last evaluated body expression.

special_forms.name: defmacro
special_forms.summary: Define a macro with hygienic local `def` and `make-history` scoping.

special_forms.name: make-history
special_forms.summary: Create a history cell for feedback.

special_forms.name: read-history
special_forms.summary: Read the previous frame from a history cell.

special_forms.name: write-history
special_forms.summary: Write the current frame to a history cell and return the written signal.

special_forms.name: make-tensor-history
special_forms.summary: Create a tensor history cell for recurrent tensor DSP.

special_forms.name: read-tensor-history
special_forms.summary: Read the previous tensor value from a tensor history cell.

special_forms.name: write-tensor-history
special_forms.summary: Write the current tensor value and return it.

special_forms.summary: Resolve the lowered modulated value for a parameter declared with `@mod true`.
